name: Job Smith 2d
bioAdditions: Son of Job Smith 1st & Elizabeth Thompson (John's 9th-great-granduncle). Pelletreau (S1) names two daughters important to the cousin web: Anna, who married first Ebenezer Smith (son of Richard 2d) and second Zephaniah Platt, and died 12 Mar 1813; and Charity, first wife of Edmund Smith 2d. Through Anna and Charity, Judge J. Lawrence Smith, James Clinch Smith, Bessie Smith White and the Bailey and Platt cousins all descend from Job Smith 1st, John's own ancestor.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 465-466, 475-476
sources.supports: Anna dau. of Job 2d m. Ebenezer Smith then Zephaniah Platt; Edmund 2d m. 1st Charity dau. of Job 2d

researchLogEntry: Round 4: daughters Anna and Charity documented in Pelletreau; key link for the closer J. Lawrence Smith routes.
